aiot.conclusion: Confirmed native protection fill, not missing stop or unclosed position. Price differences explain 0.3595 gross loss above plan; planned risk is not an actual-loss guarantee. Other ten trades sum +0.32633938, a concentration description, not permission to exclude this loser.

one.rule: Hold >=90 minutes, positive gross profit and estimated net/planned loss <0.25
one.conclusion: Exit followed existing rule while hourly averages remained bearishly aligned. Current S8 stagnation rule has no trend-takeover exception; study conditional continuation, not blanket holding extension.

koma_large.management: 30 percent reduced at >=5 percent; remaining peak 8.898 percent to 6.605 percent exceeds 2 percentage-point drawdown.

koma_small.conclusion: Mark-based estimated profit was not realized at the actual exit price. No contemporaneous order book audit, so spread, latency and liquidity causes remain unassigned.

postexit_paths.anchors: First fully-after-flat minute close, not actual exit price; no costs, not executable delayed-exit PnL.
postexit_paths.inference: ONE warrants research, whereas the profitable KOMA exit preceded an adverse rebound; uniform holding extension is not supported.

reentry.interpretation: Descriptive, bounded historical association, not proof of missing reset or independent waves. Nov9 same-side result is counter-evidence to blanket bans based on Nov4-8 same-side losses.

retained_gain_top10.denominator: Retained stratified samples, not all-day counts or independent opportunities.

merl_positive_case.conclusion: Candidate for independent relative-strength/regime-gate replay, not proof that removing one gate would admit or profit.

volume_replay.added: ONE short once, TST long twice

rejections.conclusion: No basis for uniformly removing/reducing volume or ATR gates. Counterfactual candidate changes are not fills or profitability.
